items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Oh, Albert Brooks, yeah I really like him. ... But I know I admire him.

ctx.x: Oh, Albert Brooks, yeah I really like him. Oh I can’t think of anyone else right off the top of my head. But I know I admire him. Oh, and I like Christopher Guest and Harry Shearer, the guys that did “Spinal Tap,” and I also like the people who did “Best of Show,” the dog movie that’s current. I don’t know if you’ve seen that yet.
I have not seen that yet. It sounds like a good subject.
